newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson wins 1.8 bln skr China order.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson wins 1.8 bln skr China order.

text.p: Swedish telecoms giant LM Ericsson AB said on Thursday it had won an 1.8 billion crown order from Guangdong Mobile Communications Corp for increased mobile telephony capacity and coverage of Guangdong province.
Ericsson said in a statement the contract covered the introduction of its GSM-based DCS 1800 technology and the extension of subscriber capacity for digital GSM systems in the province.

"When the project is terminated in 1997, the GSM network in Guangdong will cater for 2.5 million users and the mobile phone network in the region will be able to serve a total of four million subscribers," Ericsson said.
